milestones.title: M0: Foundation
milestones.description: Monorepo, tooling, authentication, tenancy, audit, health checks, launcher and engineering documentation.

milestones.title: M1: Customers and templates
milestones.description: Customer accounts and contacts, provider/customer memberships, reusable implementation templates and the dependency graph domain.

milestones.title: M2: Projects and tasks
milestones.description: Template snapshot instantiation, project lifecycle, tasks, subtasks, dependencies, comments and schedule rebaseline.

milestones.title: M3: Milestones and evidence
milestones.description: Milestone submission gates, immutable customer review rounds, local file storage and deliverable versioning.

milestones.title: M4: Risks, health and launch
milestones.description: Risk and blocker register, rule-based project health from SQL, progress, portfolio dashboard and launch gates.

milestones.title: M5: Customer portal and communications
milestones.description: Customer portal with query-layer visibility filtering, activity timeline, in-app notifications and work queue.

milestones.title: M6: Reporting and hardening
milestones.description: Portfolio reporting, CSV export, audit history, demo dataset, acceptance suite, accessibility and deployment.

tickets.title: Set up monorepo, tooling and CI pipeline
tickets.description: npm workspaces for api, web and shared packages with strict TypeScript, ESLint, Prettier, Vitest and a GitHub Actions pipeline with a PostgreSQL service and secret scanning.
acceptanceCriteria: `./run.sh check` runs lint, format, typecheck, unit and integration tests
CI runs the same gates on every pull request

tickets.title: Implement forward-only migration runner and foundation schema
tickets.description: Lexically ordered SQL migrations applied in transactions with checksums, plus the organizations, users, sessions and audit_events tables.
acceptanceCriteria: Re-running migrations is a no-op
Editing an applied migration aborts startup

tickets.title: Implement session authentication with scrypt, CSRF and rate limiting
tickets.description: Local email/password login with scrypt hashes, opaque server-side sessions in httpOnly SameSite cookies, origin plus token CSRF defence and login rate limiting.
acceptanceCriteria: Wrong passwords return a generic 401
Unsafe requests without a CSRF token return 403

tickets.title: Add error envelope, request ids, health checks and structured logging
tickets.description: Consistent success/error envelope, AppError codes, request correlation ids, pino logging with redaction, liveness and readiness probes.
acceptanceCriteria: Unknown routes return a 404 envelope
Readiness returns 503 when PostgreSQL is unreachable

tickets.title: Provide run.sh launcher and development environment bootstrap
tickets.description: Single bash entry point that installs dependencies, creates .env with a random session secret, creates the database, migrates, seeds and launches API and web.
acceptanceCriteria: `./run.sh` takes a fresh clone to a running app
`./run.sh help` lists every subcommand

tickets.title: Define LaunchDesk actor model and role constraint migration
tickets.description: Replace placeholder roles with the five PRD actors, add a CHECK constraint on users.role and bind customer-side users to exactly one customer account.
acceptanceCriteria: Inserting an unknown role fails at the database
Customer roles without a customer account are rejected

tickets.title: Write architecture documentation, ADRs and engineering backlog
tickets.description: Architecture overview, quality attributes, system design, data model, OpenAPI contract, threat model, test strategy, runbook, roadmap, backlog and ADRs 0001-0017.
acceptanceCriteria: Every PRD endpoint appears in openapi.yaml with x-status and x-ticket
backlog.json matches backlog.md

tickets.title: Customer accounts API: list, create and get (tenant-scoped)
tickets.description: Vertical slice for customer accounts with shared zod schemas, repository, service and routes. Reads are limited to provider roles, creation to provider admins, and creation is audited in the same transaction.
acceptanceCriteria: Org B receives 404 for an Org A customer id
Customer-portal users receive 403 on list
Duplicate names in one org return 409
customer.created audit row commits with the insert

tickets.title: Customer accounts screen with list and create form
tickets.description: Paginated customer list with status badges and an admin-only create form with inline validation errors.
acceptanceCriteria: List renders seeded customers
Create form is hidden for non-admin roles

tickets.title: Seed development tenants, demo users and customer accounts
tickets.description: Development-only seed for Northstar Cloud and a second provider organization with one demo login per role and a few customer accounts per tenant.
acceptanceCriteria: Seed is idempotent
Seed refuses to run with NODE_ENV=production

tickets.title: Customer account update and soft archive
tickets.description: PATCH customer account details with optimistic locking and an archive/unarchive action. Archived customers cannot receive new projects but keep history.
acceptanceCriteria: Archived customer is rejected by project creation with 422
Archive and unarchive write audit events

tickets.title: Provider and customer membership model for multi-entity users
tickets.description: Introduce provider_memberships and customer_memberships so one identity can belong to several providers or customers, with an active-context switch in the session.
acceptanceCriteria: A user with two memberships can switch context
Session role always reflects the active membership

tickets.title: Customer contacts API and screen
tickets.description: List and add customer contacts under /customers/:id/contacts with local-only demo credentials and no email invitations.
acceptanceCriteria: Contacts are scoped to provider org and customer
No outbound email is attempted

tickets.title: Template schema migration
tickets.description: Tables for implementation_templates, template_phases, template_tasks, template_task_dependencies and template_milestones with tenant keys and FKs.
acceptanceCriteria: Cross-tenant FK references are impossible
Indexes exist on (provider_org_id, template_id)

tickets.title: Template CRUD and duplicate API
tickets.description: Create, read, update, archive and duplicate templates including phases, tasks, owner side, offsets, evidence rules and milestones.
acceptanceCriteria: Duplicate produces an independent copy
Only provider admins and managers can edit templates

tickets.title: Template validation endpoint with acyclic dependency check
tickets.description: POST /templates/:id/validate reuses the dependency graph domain to reject cycles and dangling references before saving.
acceptanceCriteria: Cyclic template returns 422 with the cycle path
Valid template returns a topological order

tickets.title: Template library and builder screens
tickets.description: Template list plus an editable builder for phases, tasks, dependencies and milestones with validation feedback.
acceptanceCriteria: Builder blocks save on validation errors
Keyboard-accessible dependency picker

tickets.title: Seed implementation templates
tickets.description: Seed SaaS Account Setup, Data Migration + Launch and Security Review + Go-Live templates.
acceptanceCriteria: Three templates exist after seed
Each template validates as acyclic

tickets.title: Shared permission matrix for object-level checks
tickets.description: Central capability map (role x action) plus helpers for project membership and visibility checks used by every service.
acceptanceCriteria: Unit tests cover every role/action pair
Services call the matrix instead of inline role lists

tickets.title: Rule-based project health calculator (pure domain)
tickets.description: Deterministic evaluation of COMPLETED, AT_RISK, WATCH and ON_TRACK at an explicit now, returning every triggered reason with machine-readable codes.
acceptanceCriteria: Each PRD rule has unit tests including the 20 percent boundary
Same input always yields the same status and reasons

tickets.title: Task dependency graph domain: cycle detection and topological order
tickets.description: Immutable graph with addDependency that rejects self, duplicate, unknown, cross-project and cyclic edges (returning the cycle path), Kahn topological ordering and derived ready/blocked state.
acceptanceCriteria: Cycle rejection names the full cycle path
Original graph is never mutated
100 percent branch coverage

tickets.title: Project, phase, task and dependency schema migration
tickets.description: Tables for projects, project_memberships, project_phases, project_tasks, task_dependencies and task_checklist_items with version columns and composite tenant FKs.
acceptanceCriteria: A task cannot reference a project from another organization
Indexes on (provider_org_id, project_id) and due dates

tickets.title: Template snapshot instantiation on project creation
tickets.description: POST /projects copies phases, tasks, dependencies and milestones from the template into project-owned rows with due dates from kickoff offsets.
acceptanceCriteria: Editing the template afterwards leaves the project unchanged
Creation and audit commit in one transaction

tickets.title: Projects API: list and get with filters and optimistic locking
tickets.description: Paginated project list filtered by owner, customer, health, status and month; get by id; PATCH with version check returning 409 on stale writes.
acceptanceCriteria: Org B receives 404 for Org A project
Stale version returns 409

tickets.title: New-project wizard with schedule preview
tickets.description: Wizard to select customer, template, dates and owner, previewing generated tasks, milestones, responsible side and due dates.
acceptanceCriteria: Preview matches persisted result
Archived customers are not selectable

tickets.title: Project list screen with search and filters
tickets.description: Responsive table with search and owner/customer/health/status filters reflected in the URL.
acceptanceCriteria: Filters survive reload via deep link
Empty state explains how to create a project

tickets.title: Project overview screen
tickets.description: Progress, current phase, key dates, health with reasons and next actions.
acceptanceCriteria: Health reasons are visible
Next actions list ready tasks only

tickets.title: Project lifecycle state machine and transition endpoint
tickets.description: POST /projects/:id/transition enforcing DRAFT to COMPLETED transitions, with reasons required for ON_HOLD and CANCELLED.
acceptanceCriteria: Illegal transitions return 409 INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION
Every transition writes a project event and audit row

tickets.title: Tasks API with subtasks and optimistic locking
tickets.description: List, create and update project tasks and one level of subtasks with visibility, evidence flag and version checks.
acceptanceCriteria: Subtask of a subtask returns 422
Customer users never receive provider-only tasks

tickets.title: Task dependency endpoints backed by the graph domain
tickets.description: Add and remove task dependencies by loading the project graph, applying the pure domain operation and persisting under a project row lock.
acceptanceCriteria: Cycle returns 422 with the cycle path
Concurrent inserts cannot create a cycle

tickets.title: Task transitions with dependency gate and manager override
tickets.description: POST /tasks/:id/transition blocks DONE while required predecessors are incomplete unless a manager supplies an override reason.
acceptanceCriteria: Blocked completion returns 422 listing predecessors
Override reason is stored and audited

tickets.title: Task list screen with hierarchy
tickets.description: Task table grouped by phase with subtasks, owner side, assignee, due date, status and overdue markers.
acceptanceCriteria: Overdue is computed in the project timezone
Rows link to the task detail page

tickets.title: Kanban board by task status
tickets.description: Board with one column per task status; moves call the transition endpoint and surface dependency errors.
acceptanceCriteria: Blocked move shows the predecessor list
Board is operable by keyboard

tickets.title: Task detail page with checklist, dependencies and comments
tickets.description: Task page showing checklist, predecessors and successors, comments and evidence with role-appropriate actions.
acceptanceCriteria: Customer users see only shared comments
Checklist items record who completed them

tickets.title: Task comments API with visibility
tickets.description: GET/POST /tasks/:id/comments with INTERNAL or SHARED visibility filtered at the query layer.
acceptanceCriteria: Customer comment is always SHARED
Internal comments never appear in customer responses

tickets.title: Schedule rebaseline with preview and confirmation
tickets.description: POST /projects/:id/rebaseline returns a preview of moved due dates and applies them only with explicit confirmation and an audit entry.
acceptanceCriteria: Changing target go-live alone moves no due dates
Applied rebaseline is visible in history

tickets.title: Milestone schema and API
tickets.description: Tables milestones, milestone_required_tasks and milestone_reviews plus list/create under /projects/:id/milestones.
acceptanceCriteria: Required tasks must belong to the same project
Customer users see only shared milestones

tickets.title: Milestone submission gate
tickets.description: POST /milestones/:id/submit allowed for managers only when linked tasks are done and required evidence exists; opens a new review round.
acceptanceCriteria: Incomplete milestone returns 422 with missing tasks and evidence
Non-manager receives 403

tickets.title: Milestone decision with immutable review rounds
tickets.description: POST /milestones/:id/decide records accept or reject by a customer owner (or manager for internal milestones) with feedback; reviews are append-only.
acceptanceCriteria: Rejection requires resubmission as a new round
Acceptance records approver and timestamp

tickets.title: Milestones timeline screen
tickets.description: Timeline of milestones with target dates, status and review history.
acceptanceCriteria: Prior review rounds are listed
Submit action only for managers

tickets.title: Local file storage service with type and size validation
tickets.description: Streamed uploads to UPLOAD_DIR with random stored names, MIME/extension allow-list, size limit and SHA-256 checksum.
acceptanceCriteria: Disallowed types return 422
Files are never served with an executable content type

tickets.title: Task and project file endpoints with visibility-enforced download
tickets.description: Upload and list files on tasks, milestones and projects with INTERNAL or SHARED_WITH_CUSTOMER scope; download checks tenant, project and visibility.
acceptanceCriteria: Customer download of an internal file returns 404
Files remain downloadable after restart

tickets.title: Deliverable version history and shared files screen
tickets.description: Each re-upload creates a new version record; the files screen shows current and older revisions with access classification.
acceptanceCriteria: Older revisions remain downloadable
Access classification badge on every row

tickets.title: Customer milestone acceptance page
tickets.description: Customer-owner page to accept or reject a submitted milestone with feedback and evidence links.
acceptanceCriteria: Customer members see the page read-only
Reject requires feedback text

tickets.title: Risk and blocker register API
tickets.description: risk_items table and /projects/:id/risks endpoints with type, severity, owner, mitigation, launch_blocking and open age.
acceptanceCriteria: Only launch_blocking open items affect launch and health
Status changes are audited

tickets.title: Project health and progress from SQL records
tickets.description: Load health inputs from tasks, milestones and risks and run the pure health calculator; progress is completed required tasks over total with a documented zero rule.
acceptanceCriteria: Opening a blocking risk yields AT_RISK with its reason
Resolving it recalculates deterministically

tickets.title: Risk register screen
tickets.description: Register with severity, owner, next action, open age and launch-blocking filter.
acceptanceCriteria: Launch-blocking items are visually distinct
Empty state for projects with no risks

tickets.title: Launch gates for READY_FOR_LAUNCH and LIVE
tickets.description: READY_FOR_LAUNCH requires launch-blocking tasks done, required milestones accepted and no open blocking risks; LIVE requires a manager confirmation and records the actual go-live date and decision.
acceptanceCriteria: Early go-live returns 422 listing unmet gates
LIVE persists actual date and decision log entry

tickets.title: Portfolio dashboard with health and upcoming go-lives
tickets.description: Provider home showing projects by health, upcoming go-lives and overdue tasks by side, all derived from SQL.
acceptanceCriteria: Numbers match database counts
Health reasons visible on hover and focus

tickets.title: Role-specific home routing for provider and customer users
tickets.description: After login, provider roles land on the portfolio and customer roles on the customer portal; provider navigation is never shown to customers.
acceptanceCriteria: Customer users cannot reach provider routes
Deep links redirect correctly after login

tickets.title: Customer portal API with query-layer visibility filtering
tickets.description: /customer/projects, /customer/projects/:id and /customer/tasks/:id return only the caller customer account data and customer-visible rows.
acceptanceCriteria: Another customer project returns 404 without metadata
Provider-only task by direct id returns 404

tickets.title: Customer portal home and project portal screens
tickets.description: Customer home across accessible projects and a project portal with deliverables, pending tasks, milestones and comments, visually distinct from the provider workspace.
acceptanceCriteria: Only customer-visible items render
Pending customer actions are listed first

tickets.title: Project activity timeline and decision register
tickets.description: project_events written alongside state changes and GET /projects/:id/activity with internal entries excluded for customer users.
acceptanceCriteria: Customer timeline excludes internal events
Launch decisions appear in the decision register

tickets.title: In-app notifications and idempotent reminder worker
tickets.description: notifications table, /notifications endpoints and a periodic checker for due and overdue tasks keyed to avoid duplicates.
acceptanceCriteria: Running the checker twice creates no duplicates
Notifications can be marked read

tickets.title: Notifications and personal work queue screen
tickets.description: Notification list with mark-as-read and a personal queue of assigned open tasks.
acceptanceCriteria: Unread count updates after marking read
Queue sorts by due date

tickets.title: Portfolio reports API
tickets.description: GET /reports/portfolio with planned vs actual go-live, average cycle duration, overdue tasks by side, common blockers and acceptance turnaround.
acceptanceCriteria: Every figure is computed from SQL
Filters match the project list filters

tickets.title: CSV export of filtered project data
tickets.description: GET /reports/export.csv streams the currently authorized filter with formula-injection-safe cells.
acceptanceCriteria: CSV rows equal the filtered list
Cells starting with = + - @ are escaped

tickets.title: Reporting screen with charts
tickets.description: Charts and KPI tiles for portfolio reports using locally bundled assets only.
acceptanceCriteria: No external asset requests
Charts have accessible text alternatives

tickets.title: Audit log API and team and settings screen
tickets.description: GET /audit-logs for provider admins with filters, plus team membership and organization settings screen.
acceptanceCriteria: Non-admins receive 403
Audit entries are read-only

tickets.title: Full demonstration dataset and golden scenario seed
tickets.description: Seed 8-12 projects across health states, 100+ tasks with dependencies, 20+ milestones, 10 risks and several approval rounds, including the Atlas Retail golden scenario.
acceptanceCriteria: Seed is deterministic and idempotent
Golden scenario starts at step 1

tickets.title: Playwright acceptance suite L-01 to L-10
tickets.description: Browser tests against real SQL data for portfolio, project creation, snapshots, cycles, dependency gates, evidence and milestone reviews.
acceptanceCriteria: L-01 to L-10 pass in CI
Database reset before the suite

tickets.title: Playwright acceptance suite L-11 to L-19
tickets.description: Browser tests for health, launch gates, customer isolation, tenant isolation, rebaseline, restart persistence and CSV export.
acceptanceCriteria: L-11 to L-19 pass in CI
Restart test reuses persisted files

tickets.title: Tenant and customer isolation regression suite
tickets.description: API-level suite that iterates every resource endpoint as another tenant and another customer and asserts 403/404 without leaked fields.
acceptanceCriteria: Every registered route is covered
Responses contain no foreign identifiers

tickets.title: Accessibility and responsive UX pass
tickets.description: WCAG 2.1 AA review of all screens: focus management in dialogs, contrast, keyboard navigation and responsive tables.
acceptanceCriteria: Automated axe checks pass on core screens
Dialogs trap and restore focus

tickets.title: Production container image and deployment pipeline
tickets.description: Multi-stage container image, migration step in CD and environment-specific configuration for the planned production topology.
acceptanceCriteria: Image runs as non-root
Migrations run before new instances receive traffic
